material.description: USGS describes topographic maps as representing natural and human-made features and the shape of the land, including terrain represented through contour lines; the page also explains distance and direction. This supports the descriptive function stated in Claim A, not the safety or currency of any particular route.
material.locator: USGS, “Finding Your Way With Map and Compass”, introductory explanation of topographic maps and passages describing natural and human-made features, land shape/contours, distance and direction.
